meaning_en: An error the harness has no finer code for; {detail} is its raw English text
Several notes; render each of {parts} in order
--reason is required and must not be empty: it says why, and is kept with the change
meaning_zh: 需要写明原因（不能为空），原因会和这次改动一起记下

meaning_en: {var} is not set — set it to the directory that holds this client's .env and database. The current directory is never used as a default: agent shells reset it, and a wrong one lands credentials and data in the wrong place
meaning_zh: 还没有设置 {var}：请把它设为存放这个客户 .env 和数据库的目录。不会默认使用当前目录——助手的终端会切换目录，用错目录会把凭据和数据放错地方

meaning_en: {var}={value} is a relative path — set it to an absolute path; the current directory is never used
meaning_zh: {var}={value} 是相对路径，请改成绝对路径（不会使用当前目录）

meaning_en: {name} is required — set it in the process environment or in one of the env files searched: {searched}
meaning_zh: 缺少 {name}：请在进程环境变量里设置，或写进已查找的 env 文件之一：{searched}

meaning_en: raw/{source}/{name} already holds different bytes; a raw file is written once and never replaced — save the new data under a new name. Nothing was written
meaning_zh: 原始数据 raw/{source}/{name} 已存在且内容不同；原始数据只写一次、从不覆盖，请用新名字保存。未写入任何内容

meaning_en: {name} is not a plain file or folder name (no path separator, no leading dot, not empty)
meaning_zh: {name} 不是合法的文件名或目录名（不能含路径分隔符、不能以点开头、不能为空）

meaning_en: Nothing to import: {path} is not a readable file
meaning_zh: 无法导入：{path} 不是可读取的文件

meaning_en: STALE DATA — {stale} (each: table, last day, days behind, most days allowed) — refresh the data before acting on this
meaning_zh: 数据过期：{stale}（每项：表、最后一天、落后天数、允许的最多天数）——请先更新数据再据此行动

meaning_en: ASSUMED (not stored): this run uses {assumed} instead of the values in effect
meaning_zh: 假设值（未保存）：本次运行使用 {assumed}，而不是当前生效的值

meaning_en: SHORT WINDOW — only {days_found} of {days_requested} requested days ({start}..{end}) have data, so results rest on {days_found} day(s); no rows for {missing}; per source: {gaps}; backfill: {next}
meaning_zh: 数据天数不足：请求的 {days_requested} 天（{start} 至 {end}）里只有 {days_found} 天有数据，结果只基于这 {days_found} 天；缺少：{missing}；各数据源缺少：{gaps}；补数据命令：{next}

meaning_en: PARTIAL SOURCE — some sources have no rows for some requested days: {gaps}; backfill: {next}
meaning_zh: 部分数据源缺天：{gaps}；补数据命令：{next}

meaning_en: {prog}: the command is not written the way it takes it: {detail}
